items.q: He told me, he says, in the orchestra, he says, from now on, he says, I want a, he says, I want a, I want a Jewish guy in my orchestra for luck.

ctx.x: Yeah, Henry Bussey. Yeah, I see him. He told me, he says, you know something? He says, in the orchestra, he says, from now on, he says, I want a, he says, I want a, I want a Jewish guy in my orchestra for luck. And he says, I want a dago in there to pimp on the Jew when he gets to, and he says, I'll be all right.

Henry Bussey told me. You want to hear a cute story about Bernie. Let me, let me get on with the owls here. We want to take one second. This is about when he was a conductor, contractor for the, uh, Sammy Davis Jr. show in New Orleans at the, the performing arts. And he wanted, oh, should have cut the book. And I mean, they, they got a book that, believe me, it takes a musician to cut it. And he got the best musicians in town to play the show. And they did a hell of a job.
